record_notice: Mixed collection of three kinds. Six records are sourced: their cooking facts are summarized in this project's own words from the pages each record cites. Seven are original practical notes written here for a small air fryer, citing nothing because they claim nothing that needs a citation. Three are fixtures, authored to exercise the content contract, and are not knowledge records at all. Nothing in the collection has been kitchen-tested here or given a professional food-safety review, and every record says which kind it is. The record_class on this manifest describes the manifest text itself, which is still original writing.
description: The Library's first themed collection. It holds recipe knowledge items with their regional variants, provenance, version history, and rights review kept as first-class record fields rather than presentation state.
scope_note: Contains sixteen records of three kinds. Six are sourced beginner oven recipes, each citing the page its quantities, oven temperature and timings come from, plus the food-safety authority behind any temperature threshold it states; they are editorially checked against those sources but untested in any kitchen here and not publication-ready. Seven are original practical notes in the Quick Air-Fryer section, written here rather than retrieved: they carry no sources because they make no claim about any published recipe, and where one gives a cook-to temperature it hands the reader back to their own food-safety authority. Three are illustrative fixture records, seeded so the hall, gallery, search, region filter and detail views can be built and checked end to end. No record carries an image, an authenticity claim, or a cooking-test result. A sourced record requires record_class 'sourced', at least one identified source URL, and a rights review; a practical note requires record_class 'practical-note' and no sources at all. The content rules in src/rules.mjs enforce both gates.

sections.title: Quick Air-Fryer
sections.intro: Seven original practical notes for one small air fryer and an ordinary supermarket shop, five of them vegetarian. Each gives a temperature in Celsius, a time, and the single check that actually decides when the food is done. None has been cooked in a test kitchen or reviewed by a food-safety professional, and none cites a source, because none is claiming one.

change_history.change: Shortened the Quick Air-Fryer section introduction to the context a reader needs at a glance, dropping the dish-by-dish enumeration and the timing generalization while keeping every disclaimer. The section is now presented as a lens over the single catalogue rather than as a second list of its members. Membership, order, record classes, sources, and rights are unchanged.

Added the Quick Air-Fryer section: seven original practical notes, a new record class that is neither sourced nor fixture, placed between the sourced oven set and the three fixtures. The collection gained its first editorial section, which groups those seven without changing anyone's membership. No existing record changed.

Added four further sourced beginner oven recipes — chicken thigh, salmon, halloumi and chickpea, and root vegetable — after the two already released and before the three fixtures. The three fixtures and the two earlier sourced records are unchanged in substance.
Added two sourced beginner oven recipes ahead of the three existing fixtures, which are unchanged. The collection is now mixed, and the notice and scope note say so.
Initial fixture collection created alongside the first Library framework build. No prior version exists.

rights.content_license: Original text authored for this repository; reusable under the repository's own terms once the owner sets them. Rights in the pages the sourced records cite remain with their authors and publishers.
